name: With rugs: the RÅDMANSÖ king with a RÅDMANSÖ nightstand on each side, the RÅDMANSÖ 6-drawer dresser opposite, the 66in Blue teddy bench at the foot, the TIOKRONA jute under the bed
notes:

Don't want it.", F-27). The TIOKRONA stays under the bed, this variant's jute rug run along the bed; a lays RUUGME's Ivory 6x9 across the bed's lower third, the photo's way. Later: "don't like that ottoman, give me at least 5 options to choose from, don't include things that are short", of HULALA HOME's 59" Golden, and of the options read: "I like https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FXG31XPH?th=1 the most I think, what colors ar ebest?": the 66" teddy storage bench in Blue stands at the foot. 11 placed, 11 extras.

We don't need the samller nightstand. We don't nee dpoang chair in that room."). 10 placed, 12 extras.
A king fits one way only: headboard end on the right (bathroom) wall, between the heater's face (3" off the wall, F-33) and the bottom wall: 130" for two nightstands, the frame and the walk. With both RÅDMANSÖ (21 1/4" each along the wall) and the 79 1/8" frame, 2 3/8" are left: the window nightstand takes F-33's 6" off the heater's face, the bed stands at y 30.25-109.375, and the bathroom nightstand ends 2 3/8" short of the bottom wall. The bed's bathroom side is the walk to the bathroom, 23 5/8" wide (walkway-narrow:23.6; F-30 and F-31's landing by Andrew's word), and the bathroom door opens into the bathroom (Andrew, 2026-10-26), so nothing swings into it.

F-33: bedding 28 3/4" from the heater's face. Its sloped headboard (40 1/2") stands against the wall under the art; 7 7/8" under the frame. Both on legs with 12 5/8" under, a drawer and a shelf each, a cable slot for a charger (where the outlets are is still open). The planner's warnings `in front of the bathroom` for the bed and this nightstand stand on Andrew's word.
lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS bamboo wall lamps (top): on the head wall over the nightstands, x 172-177, y 16.9-23.9 and 115.75-122.75, mirrored about the bed's center line (y 69.8), about 24" above the mattress: a soft glow (5.9 W), bedside light, not a reading light (a swing-arm reading lamp for each side is still to find). Plug-in on a 7' 3" cord in a cover along the head wall to an outlet, never down past the heater. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide 55x22" (top): right wall over the bed, centered, x 176-177, y 42.3-97.3, 18.4" from each lamp; its bottom edge about 50" off the floor, 9 1/2" above the headboard, on two closed security hangers into anchors, since Maddie climbs on the bed (F-21). night-light-1 TÖVÄDER battery night light (top) on the bathroom nightstand, x 168-171, y 112-118, on its 8-hour timer: the glow for the night walk, no cord.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 7'10"x9'10" jute (rug): rot 0, x 40-158, y 22.8-116.8, centered on the bed's width: under its lower 68.4" (78%), 7.4" out on each side and 49.6" past the foot, 19.8" off the heater's face (F-33) and 16.2" short of the bottom wall; on two STOPP FILT underlays (extras). Its page says "Do not wash" and never a rotating brush. bench-1 66" Storage Bench for Bedroom Upholstered End of Bed Bench King Size, Blue, 66 x 18 x 22" (floor): across the foot, rot 90, x 69.625-87.625, y 36.8125-102.8125, centered on the bed and 2" off the footboard so the duvet hangs free, on the TIOKRONA. Andrew's pick ("I like https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FXG31XPH?th=1 the most I think"). Length: 83% of the 79 1/8" frame, 6 9/16" in from each side, long for the 2/3 to 3/4 rule but not short, which he ruled out. Height: 22" at its cut-out arms, 6 1/4" over the 15 3/4" footboard. Teddy fabric, warm to sit on (F-27). Color (F-68 (9)): a deep denim-navy, the third cool note with the Sea Teal curtains and the teal, green and blue bedding, a shade darker than the teal so they read as family; blue sits opposite the honey oak's orange, so both look richer, and the ivory rug keeps the navy and the walnut off the floor. Its legs are silver, against the dresser's brass knobs; the same bench in Brown (rust) or Olive Green comes on gold. F-33: 33 13/16" from the heater's face. Lift-top storage; two pillows.
plant-1 FEJKA areca palm (floor): on the floor in the window-side corner where the reading chair stood, x 1.5-6.25, y 15-19.75, 12" off the heater's face. dresser-1 RÅDMANSÖ 6-drawer dresser, brown walnut effect, 62 5/8 x 18 7/8 x 31 7/8" (floor): the left wall, opposite the king (Andrew, 2026-11-10: "radmanso drawers will be placed on the wall opposite the bed"), rot 270, x 0-18.875, y 35-97.625, 3 1/2" off the bed's center line and 5 3/8" from the left door's swing (F-31, assumed-position:door); F-32: 50 3/4" from its drawer fronts to the bench; F-33: 32" below the heater's face; the closet's landing clear; anchor-required (F-21: 31 7/8"). If he means the 3- or 5-drawer RÅDMANSÖ, it stands on the same line, the same 18 7/8" deep.
Walkways (F-30): from the door to the bathroom along the bottom of the room, 30 3/16" below the bench's lower end (F-30's 30" met; 36" preferred), then the bed's bathroom side, 23 5/8" to the door (walkway-narrow:23.6); 50 3/4" between the dresser's fronts and the bench up to the window side, and 33 13/16" between the bench's top end and the heater's face; the closet's 36" landing stays clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet).
